source: MDPI/PMC paper, Section 4.5 G-PURE and SG-PURE Reactions
description: Paper-anchored SG-PURE 2.0 initial-condition overrides, mapped onto the public-pool species currently represented in simulate_sixgene_pool_chain_v3.py.
assumptions: Template DNA total is handled separately by the gene panel and remains 2.8 nM total.
Commercial/custom PUREfrex 2.0 internal translation machinery concentrations are not listed in the paper section and are therefore not overridden here.
KP_i is mapped onto the reduced public-pool species PO4 in v3.
NAD+, TPP, Mg(OAc)2, and glucose are now represented as coarse public-pool state variables for SG-PURE reconstruction, but they are not yet coupled to an explicit sugar-side reaction module.
The fixed glycolysis-side enzymes reported in the paper are still recorded below as unmapped because current v3 does not yet represent them as explicit catalytic states.
